name: value-utilities/typography
description: Typography utility families. `text-<size>` unpacks the [size, options] tuple from theme.fontSize per `corePlugins.js` fontSize plugin (font-size + line-height by default; +letter-spacing/+font-weight when present). `text-<size>/<lh>` overrides line-height. `font-<weight|family>` shares the prefix between `theme.fontWeight` and `theme.fontFamily` — Tailwind tries weight first, falls through to family. `leading-`, `tracking-`, `indent-` are simple value plugins. Negation supported by `-tracking-` and `-indent-` (mirrors corePlugins.js's `supportsNegativeValues: true` on letterSpacing and textIndent). Static text-align/text-transform/font-style/text-decoration/vertical-align/text-overflow utilities round out the set.
